original_description: Create and use AI voice clones for voices you own or have permission to use. Get help with consent, recording setup, sample preparation, clone settings, testing, troubleshooting, pronunciation, emotional range, multilingual dubbing, speech-to-speech, and scripts tailored to a voice style. Use the results for videos, podcasts, audiobooks, courses, ads, voice agents, character voices, and business workflows, with guidance on licensing, security, responsible use, and developer APIs. Responses may include a clearly disclosed Voice Cloning affiliate link.
